purpose: Teach: 霊魂/病床/擬似/昇華/接合/減免/詰め込ん/付託

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ブランドの霊魂的な精神を社員に伝えろ
lines.en: Communicate the brand's spiritual essence to every employee.
lines.style: Measured, commanding but not harsh. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. Slightly forward in posture. A leader who expects understanding, not just compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。病床の社員には休職制度をご案内します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure staff on medical leave are guided through the proper procedures.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Direct eye contact held. Voice steady and assured—showing he's already thought this through. A note of care underneath the professionalism.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、擬似商品との差別化を明確にしろ
lines.en: Distinguish us clearly from counterfeit competitors.
lines.style: Clipped, definitive. No room for interpretation. Sits back slightly—the weight of expectation in the silence after each sentence. Calm but unmissable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の不満を改善案に昇華します
lines.en: Understood. I'll transform staff concerns into concrete improvement proposals.
lines.style: Energetic but controlled. A slight lean forward showing investment in the task. Voice carries quiet confidence—he's already mapping out next steps. Responsive and proactive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、合併と接合を巧みに進めろ
lines.en: Navigate the merger and integration carefully, strategically.
lines.style: Deliberate, almost conversational in its precision. Slight pause before key words. The tone of someone who has seen deals falter—this is serious but not panicked. Grounded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様への料金減免案を準備しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already prepared a fee reduction package for our key clients.
lines.style: Assured, almost quietly proud. A touch of anticipation in the delivery—he's ready to move. Voice modulates up slightly on 'already prepared,' showing initiative. Professional but personable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業務を詰め込んだ働き方を見直せ
lines.en: Reevaluate how we're packing too much into the workday.
lines.style: Firm but tinged with genuine concern. Not angry—more exasperated at a pattern he's watched too long. A pause before 'packing'—the weight of that word. Engaged as a human, not just a manager.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。重要案件は専門委員会に付託します
lines.en: Yes. I'll refer the priority cases to the specialist committee.
lines.style: Concise, professional close. Voice settles into a lower register—grounded, final. A note of relief that proper channels exist. Respectful but assured. This closes the loop.
